proposedCopy.subscriptionGuide: Sharing a purchase and sharing calendar data are separate choices. If a particular purchase is eligible for Apple Family Sharing, that concerns access to its paid features; it is not a calendar invitation. Check the current purchase information for eligibility, then use the appropriate calendar-sharing flow and review each recipient’s access.
proposedCopy.sharingGuide: A relative does not receive calendar access just because a paid plan is available to them. Share the intended calendar separately, have them use the appropriate signed-in identity, and check the resulting Reader, Writer or Owner access. Provider sharing has its own permissions.

avoidClaims: All Cloud Calendars subscriptions support Family Sharing.
Buying Premium automatically invites family members or shares events.

Every calendar recipient must have been individually invited by email.
Cancelling a purchase automatically removes shared-calendar access or erases copies.
